composition_subtypes.role: compute shortest distances from a, b, c using BFS
sort prices ascending to assign cheapest to most used edges
use prefix sums on sorted prices to minimize trip cost greedily

payload.core_composition_summary: BFS computes distances; sorting and prefix sums enable greedy cost assignment; loop enumerates optimal meeting point.
payload.rationale: The solution first runs BFS from a, b, c to get distances. Then sorts prices and computes prefix sums for O(1) cost queries. Finally iterates over vertices to find the minimum cost by combining distances and prefix sums. This coordinates complete search (BFS), sorting, and greedy assignment.
